officialTitle: Impact of Activity-Dependent Plasticity on Bladder Function After Pediatric Spinal Cord Injury

arms.label: Locomotor Training
arms.description: Assessments for bladder function will be conducted pre-training and following 80 sessions of locomotor training. Locomotor training consists of body-weight supported stepping on a treadmill for one hour.

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Supra-sacral, non-progressive spinal cord injury
* Bladder dysfunction post-injury

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of anti-spasticity medications or unwillingness to wean off of medications
* Botox (onabotulinumtoxinA) in the bladder within 9 months of the study
* Bladder dysfunction or urinary tract impairment prior to injury

collaborators: The Leona M. and Harry B. Helmsley Charitable Trust
